text:
maya: quick heads-up — onboarding Meridian customer's LoRA adapter into dedicated serving. need a short warmstart + compat smoke across quant configs (int8/4bit), tokenizer mapping, and a quick eval deck. putting together eval pack now.

jia: thanks — can you drop model/artifact link and target SLOs?

maya: s3://cust-meridian/lora_v1.tar.gz. target median latency < 120ms @ batch=1, 95%+ pass rate on our convo QA suite, and no more than -0.5 BLEU vs base on short-form.

oscar: noted. FYI we saw tokenization drift last week with a different Meridian adapter — they use a spaCy-based preprocessor which emits nonstandard emoji sequences. could be vocab mapping issue.

oscar: example tokenizer load snippet:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file("meridian_tokenizer.json")
# check unknown tokens: tokenizer.encode("\U0001F600").tokens
```

sami: i'll spin up quant runs now: nf4 + awq + int8 baseline. also will test KV warmstart behavior for seq_len 512 and 2048.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued -> pool: dedicated-pool-3, image: rwd-infer:prod-2026-03-19, job: meridian-lora-smoke-2598765432

eval-bot: quick eval finished (short-form split). Summary: BLEU delta = -0.8, QA F1 delta = -2.1%. Artifacts: /evals/2598765432/results (CSV + per-case diffs).

maya: dang. which cases drive BLEU drop?

eval-bot: top failures are short-form generative prompts with emoji and triple-slash separators. error pattern: tokenized as multiple unknown tokens causing output shift.

terry: i can try a tokenizer remap to unify emoji sequences to single token and rerun merge. also will inspect attention remapping during kernel selection — sometimes quant kernels don't handle special token ids consistently.

jia: as a quick mitigation can we try hybrid precision: fp16 for embeddings + first/last transformer blocks, nf4 for mid layers? possible config: 
```yaml
quant_profile:
  - layer_set: [embeddings, first_block, last_block]
    dtype: fp16
  - layer_set: rest
    dtype: nf4
```

oscar: i tested that locally on a subset — QA delta improved to -0.6 and BLEU to -0.4. also fixed a warmstart cache mismatch when KV prefix len was forced to 128.

maya: great. next steps: 1) terry apply tokenizer remap + update merge script, 2) sami run full eval pack overnight with hybrid quant_profile, 3) schedule canary rollout on dedicated-pool-3 with fallback to base model if QA drops >1.5%. I'll post results tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

terry: will do. pushing tokenizer remap in a branch and adding tests for emoji anchors.

sami: running full eval now — will attach logs to /evals/2598765432/complete. ETA ~8h.

oscar: remind me to add a tracing hook for KV warmstart mismatch so we can catch it in the console.

maya: good call. thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source for the smoke.

:eval-bot: reaction :white_check_mark: to final plan
